chunks: Al-Aṣbagh ibn Nubātah narrated from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام that he said:

“The night of al-Jumuʿah is a radiant night, and its day is a shining day. Whoever dies on the night of al-Jumuʿah, Allah writes for him immunity from the pressure of the grave, and whoever dies on the day of al-Jumuʿah, Allah writes for him immunity from the Fire.”

key_terms.بَرَاءَةً: freedom, immunity, or deliverance granted by Allah
key_terms.ضَغْطَةِ الْقَبْرِ: the constriction or pressure of the grave
key_terms.لَيْلَةُ الْجُمُعَةِ: the night preceding Friday, described here as especially radiant and blessed
key_terms.يَوْمُهَا: its day, referring to the day of Friday

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of dying on the night or day of al-Jumuʿah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the special excellence of the night and day of al-Jumuʿah. It states that one who dies during this blessed time is granted divine protection from the pressure of the grave or from the Fire, highlighting the spiritual distinction of Friday.
